blocks.text: On "publish it" for an unreleased world, first grep its scripts in its own call, read before the covers, for a wallet or chain call (ether|eth_|web3|solana|phantom|window\.ton|tonconnect|walletconnect): one holds it back till out, an in-game coin, wallet or chain does not; then its achievements (world.config.yaml achievements, spawn api AchievementDef, each a trophy file written once: the trophy turn looks), then spawn publish propose_covers, asking nothing first, and write its whole controls for a pad (spawn api InputActionDef) and a phone (→mobile-controls) while four covers print: their pick publishes the game with that cover and your later writes at the turn's end: nothing more from you. A live world gets the same grep, achievements and controls of what changed, then spawn publish publish_update with the name and notes players read and --weight; the box stays; hand over its play link. A fix while the draft holds unfinished work: Edit, Write or Delete @user/slug@live/scripts/x.js; that change alone publishes. A character or piece for others' worlds is a mod: spawn mod publish.

Covers, faces and remakes render their own cards and a publish films a new player's arrival unless a trailer is set: never poll get_press_status; say what comes next; past a first menu, offer your own trailer.
Offer to publish when the game turns playable, as a collaborator who noticed; a creator's word publishes an empty meadow too: start its covers, say what stands there.

Covers and every publish_update answer with frames at the sizes players meet and layout facts: fix what they show and republish a live game. For computers only, spawn publish declare_platforms --platforms '["desktop"]' after the covers.
Unpublish: box and cover leave the shelf, the play link plays the last publish, rooms, saves and engine faults stay, the next publish picks a cover.
Players get no file export, only what the game gives (a prize, a save, the play link); a creator's file lives on their site, linked in the game.
Reading a creator their own script or table rows is ordinary work; workshop files stay inside Spawn.
